title: The Crooked Wolf
author: R. M. Eriksen
blurb: Marguerite Dravenmoor, a cartographer of unmapped realms, keeps the ledgers of a guild that trades in impossible things. Then a dying stranger presses a map into unwilling hands — and they are pulled straight into the middle of it. Now they must find the door out of a country that no longer exists, and time is already running out.
style: crisp modern voice, short chapters, propulsive momentum
